Position Description

Oklo is seeking a Vice President of Strategy to serve as the senior leader of the company’s corporate strategy function. The function is designed to be proactive and high leverage: identifying emerging opportunities and risks, developing independent points of view, and deploying a focused team against the company’s highest-priority questions and initiatives. You will work directly with the founders, CFO, and business-unit leaders, bringing forward original recommendations, constructively challenging assumptions, and leading the Strategy function’s contribution to executive and Board decisions. title: Chief Impact Officer
description:
The Chief Impact Officer is responsible for developing and leading the organization's social impact, sustainability, ESG, and purpose-driven initiatives. The role focuses on creating measurable positive outcomes for communities, stakeholders, customers, employees, and the environment while aligning impact objectives with the organization's long-term business strategy. The CIO drives programs that enhance corporate responsibility, sustainable growth, and stakeholder value.
Key Responsibilities
Impact Strategy & Vision

• Develop and execute the organization's impact strategy aligned with corporate mission and business objectives.

• Define measurable social, environmental, and economic impact goals.

• Integrate impact priorities into enterprise-wide strategic planning.

ESG & Sustainability Leadership

• Lead ESG, sustainability, and corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives.

• Ensure alignment of impact programs with sustainability frameworks and best practices.

• Drive initiatives focused on climate action, social inclusion, and responsible governance.

Social Impact & Community Engagement

• Develop programs that create meaningful impact within communities and stakeholder groups.

• Lead partnerships with nonprofits, NGOs, government agencies, and community organizations.

• Oversee philanthropic initiatives, volunteer programs, and social investment projects.

Impact Measurement & Reporting

• Establish frameworks to measure and evaluate social and environmental impact.

• Develop KPIs, dashboards, and reporting structures for impact performance.

• Communicate outcomes and progress to leadership, investors, and stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships

• Engage with investors, clients, regulators, community leaders, and advocacy groups.

• Build strategic partnerships that strengthen organizational impact and reputation.

• Represent the organization in sustainability and impact-focused forums.

Sustainable Business Integration

• Collaborate with business units to embed impact principles into products, services, and operations.

• Support responsible investment and sustainable business initiatives.

• Identify opportunities to create shared value through innovation and strategic growth.

Governance & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with ESG, sustainability, and social responsibility standards and regulations.

• Establish governance frameworks to support accountability and transparency.

• Coordinate with legal, compliance, and risk management teams.

Employee Engagement & Culture

• Promote a purpose-driven and socially responsible organizational culture.

• Drive employee engagement initiatives related to sustainability and social impact.

• Foster diversity, equity, inclusion, and employee well-being programs.

Leadership & Organizational Development

• Lead and mentor sustainability, CSR, ESG, and impact teams.

• Build cross-functional collaboration around impact initiatives.

• Drive innovation and continuous improvement in impact strategies.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Public Policy, Business Administration, Social Sciences, or related field; Master's degree preferred.

• 12-15+ years of experience in ESG, sustainability, social impact, CSR, or related leadership roles.

• Proven experience developing and implementing impact-focused initiatives and strategies.

• Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability reporting, and stakeholder engagement.

Key Skills & Competencies

• Strong strategic and purpose-driven leadership skills.

• Expertise in ESG, sustainability, and social impact measurement.

• Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication abilities.

• Strong analytical and program management skills.

• Change management and cross-functional collaboration capabilities.

Performance Metrics

• Achievement of social and environmental impact goals.

• ESG and sustainability performance outcomes.

• Community engagement and partnership effectiveness

KiddeFenwal is a global leader in industrial and commercial fire suppression systems and safety controls. Our Purpose

We protect lives and livelihoods through innovation, trusted partnerships, and a commitment to excellence. Integrity, safety, and teamwork are the foundation of everything we do.

Regional Sales Manager - Germany

Position will be remote from your home, based in Germany. Must have close proximity to a major transportation hub.

Position Summary

The Regional Sales Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth, increasing market share, and achieving sales objectives across assigned territories with a focus on Germany but extending to other parts of Europe, with support for selected international markets as required. Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to  hundreds of thousands of businesses  and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Technical Support Engineer 2

About the job

This position is needed to support our customers’ use of Twilio’s Programmable Messaging product. This role will function as the voice of Twilio to our customers and partners and operate as a subject matter expert for Twilio’s Programmable Messaging API.

In addition, focus on providing friendly, professional customer service, while problem-solving and demonstrating a high competency in communicating complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences via phone, email, and chat mediums. Advanced time management skills are able to work well under pressure, and are proficient at developing workflows to remain efficient at tasks while still following standard processes and procedures. 

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

• Work on messaging email cases submitted by both individual developers and major brands. 

• Assist customers with troubleshooting message deliverability issues and debug customer code. 

• Speak with a customer on the phone and chat in order to guide them through the development of their SMS application. 

• Collaborate with your teammates and the Twilio Product and Engineering teams via Slack. File Jira’s to report reproducible bugs and review our internal knowledge base to stay up to speed with industry shifts and standards. 

• Work with your manager to surface customer problems to assist in process betterment.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

• 2+ years of experience in a client-facing technical role, preferably in supporting REST API or enterprise software

• A firm understanding of the technology stacks common to the Web ecosystem.

• Functional knowledge of general-purpose programming languages.

• Strong problem-solving and technical troubleshooting skills

• Ability to professionally and diplomatically address customer concerns and provide concise feedback.

• Ability to de-escalate tense/tough customer situations in a live environment. 

• Excellent reading comprehension, listening, and writing skills.

Desired:

• Previous exposure or knowledge of Twilio products.

• Coding experience in any language. (reading and debugging)

• Previous experience with JIRA or a similar ticketing system.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Colombia

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.
